name: OSRM
tagline: Open Source Routing Machine for OSM-based car routing, matrices, and map matching
description: OSRM is a high-performance routing engine for OpenStreetMap data. Its public demo provides route, nearest, table, match, trip and tile HTTP services using worldwide car, bicycle and foot profiles. Demo use is limited to reasonable, non-commercial workloads at no more than 1 request per second, without service guarantees.

auth.details: No authentication required on the public demo server; requests are unauthenticated HTTP GET. Self-hosting is recommended for production.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Sponsored public demo for reasonable, non-commercial use only; maximum 1 request per second; no scraping or heavy use. Attribution, an identifying User-Agent and a referrer where applicable are required. No uptime, latency or data-update guarantees.

rate_limits: Maximum 1 request per second; no scraping or heavy usage.
use_cases: compute driving route distance and duration between coordinates
build a distance or duration matrix for many origin-destination pairs
snap GPS traces to roads with map matching
find the nearest road network point to a coordinate
solve traveling-salesman style trip optimization for a set of stops
